## 25 Midjourney Prompts for Bestselling Phone Case Designs

*A professional resource for Print-on-Demand sellers on Etsy, Redbubble, Merch by Amazon & beyond*

## How to Use This Pack

These prompts are engineered specifically for phone case designs — not generic wallpapers or illustrations. Every prompt has been structured to produce **clean, commercially viable artwork** that translates well to curved surfaces, avoids muddy edges, and works across iPhone and Android templates.

**Before you generate, understand these non-negotiables:**

- Always append `--ar 9:20` for portrait phone case proportions
- Add `--no text, watermarks, signatures` to every prompt
- Use `--style raw` in Midjourney v6 for cleaner, less AI-looking results
- Run each prompt 4x and upscale your winner at `--q 2`
- Your final file should be exported at **minimum 4500 × 9750px** for production quality

**The anatomy of a great POD phone case prompt:**
`[Subject/Pattern] + [Style] + [Color Palette] + [Mood/Finish] + [Technical Modifiers]`

## Pro Production Checklist

Before uploading any design to your POD store:

- [ ] Image is minimum 4500px on shortest side
- [ ] Background removed or intentional (check transparent PNG for some platforms)
- [ ] Test mockup at thumbnail size — is it still readable?
- [ ] No copyrighted elements, logos, or celebrity likenesses
- [ ] No readable text generated by AI (check carefully)
- [ ] Colour profile is sRGB for screen accuracy
- [ ] Run through a copyright check tool (Google Lens reverse image)
- [ ] Title and tags on your listing match the *mood/aesthetic* not just the object

## Quick Remix Formula

Take any prompt above and swap these variables to create dozens of variations:

| Swap This | For This |
|-----------|----------|
| Colour palette | Seasons, trends, target market |
| Style (watercolour) | Line art, digital, oil, risograph |
| Density (dense pattern) | Single hero image, scattered repeat |
| Mood (romantic) | Edgy, playful, minimal, maximalist |
| Background (cream) | Black, navy, blush, sage, terracotta |

**Example:** Take Prompt #3 (Pressed Flower) → change palette to `deep purple, black and gold` + change background to `dark charcoal` = an entirely new gothic wedding niche product.
